long_biography.plain_text:
Hydrostroy, a long-established Bulgarian infrastructure contractor, is the central institution in Veliko Dimitrov Zhelev's business career. As chairman, he oversees a company whose work spans highways, water and sewerage systems, ports, airports, railways and public buildings. Its integrated capacity also includes asphalt, concrete and road-sign production.

Zhelev's training combines construction engineering with economics, industrial management and accounting. That mix suits a business which links project design, heavy machinery, materials production and maintenance. Hydrostroy's modern expansion added offices in Sofia and Burgas and projects beyond Bulgaria. Its portfolio widened from hydraulic works and wastewater treatment to transport corridors, housing and energy-related construction.
